extraction.chinese_layer: extracted cleanly and used as the reference Chinese text (with the targeted legal upgrades applied)

official_text_status.note_en: No article has been independently verified against the official Umm Al-Qura text in this repository build. Points that cannot be verified from the provided PDF are flagged NEEDS_OFFICIAL_TEXT_CHECK.

official_arabic_foundation.note_en: Foundation for the official Arabic statutory text (the future canonical legal source). A full USER-PROVIDED Arabic text candidate has been ingested and segmented into 281 article records; it is NOT yet verified against Umm Al-Qura or the Bureau of Experts. Authoritative operational record: data/official_arabic/ingestion_status.json (article records: data/official_arabic/companies_law_m132_1443_official_arabic_user_provided.json). Design/verification docs: docs/official_arabic_text/.

official_arabic_foundation.reviewer_notes: The ingested Arabic text is a user_provided_official_text_candidate, ingested_unverified. copyright_note_en: This repository contains concise reference summaries and structured metadata. It does not reproduce the full official Arabic statutory text beyond what is necessary for reference, consistent with the user-provided translation source.
